header: Top six municipalities by electricity use
lead: It is not a competition or a target. The ranking mostly follows local industry, which is why Ashcombe has been first every year since the networks merged.
note: Electricity supplied in each municipality in 2026, in GWh. The eight municipalities not listed used 256 GWh together, for a total of 1,184 GWh.

metrics.title: Ashcombe
metrics.text: Two paper mills use about half of it.

metrics.text: Down 9 GWh on 2025 after the cold store closed.
